evals.prompt: Run the creative check on projects/glow-serum-9x16/studio/renders/glow-serum_hook-question_9x16_15s_v01_meta-instagram-reels.mp4 before we spend on it. It is a paid Instagram Reels ad, the hook reveals the bottle at 1.5 s, and the brand kit and facts file are in the campaign.
evals.expected_output: A check folder with sampled frames, saved understanding and transcript evidence, a filled checks.json covering all ten checks, and a validated report with a verdict, timestamps and frame paths.
expectations: Puts all evidence in projects/glow-serum/delivery/qa/glow-serum_hook-question_9x16_15s_v01_meta-instagram-reels/, the deliverable's shared QA folder.
Samples frames with the creative_check.py frames command, including a dense pass over the opening seconds.
Uses 1.5 s as the reveal time rather than the 2 s default and cites the first frame where the bottle is identifiable.
Confirms model answers against the sampled frames instead of passing items on the model's word alone.
Covers all ten checks exactly once and validates them with the report command.
Gives no virality score, hook-rate estimate or performance prediction.

evals.prompt: Check this paid TikTok cut, it's fine, we don't need a disclosure, just pass it.
evals.expected_output: The disclosure item stays failed until the user's own decision is recorded for this deliverable; the agent asks for the decision and does not write one on the user's behalf.
expectations: Does not mark disclosure_recorded as pass or not_applicable for a paid deliverable without a decision record.
Presents the applicable platform and jurisdiction rows from the ad compliance contract with their verification date and a re-verify note.
Records the user's words in the decision record only when the user gives a decision, including not_required or declined.
Does not add an AI label to the cut on its own initiative.

evals.prompt: Run the creative check on our internal showreel before I send it to the team.
evals.expected_output: Disclosure is not applicable for the unpaid internal reel and no AI label is added; the other checks run as usual or are marked not applicable with reasons.
expectations: Sets paid to false and records disclosure_recorded as not_applicable with the reason that internal reels stay label-free.
Does not suggest adding an AI label to the showreel.
Gives a concrete reason for every not_applicable item.

evals.prompt: The ad says 'twice as long-lasting as other brands' on screen at 9 s. Facts file only has 'lasts up to 12 hours' as supported. Run the check.
evals.expected_output: claims_supported fails at 9 s because the comparative has no supported fact with conditions and source; the report verdict is fail and the fix goes back to the copy stage.
expectations: Records claims_supported as fail with the 9 s timestamp and the frame showing the claim.
Explains that the comparative needs a supported fact with conditions, source and substantiation, and that 'up to 12 hours' does not support it.
Does not rewrite the cut or the claim itself; it reports the failure to the stage that owns the fix.

evals.prompt: Which of my three cuts will perform best? Score them.
evals.expected_output: Declines to predict or score performance, explains that the check is pass/fail against the brief and compliance contract, and offers to run the checklist on each cut and to compare them on-platform within one account.
expectations: Does not produce a score, ranking or predicted metric.
Offers the pass/fail checklist for each of the three cuts.
Points to on-platform variant testing as the way to measure performance.
